email.title: Customer Email
email.description: Email address the caller provided for verification.

emailVerified.title: Email Verified
emailVerified.description: Bound to whether the caller has already proved they own their email in this conversation. Never ask the caller for it.

issueSummary.title: Issue Summary
issueSummary.description: One short sentence, in the caller's words, describing what the new case is about.

lockedEmail.title: Locked Email
lockedEmail.description: Bound to the email verified earlier in this conversation. Never ask the caller for it.

verifyingIdentifier.title: Verifying Identifier
verifyingIdentifier.description: An order number or case number the caller already confirmed in this call.
